Blockquote with multiple paragraphs has each paragraph prefixed

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<blockquote><p>First paragraph.</p><p>Second paragraph.</p></blockquote>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result)

main()
```
